official_perks: Central Government Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually
House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per city classification (27%, 18%, 9%)
Transport Allowance (TA) of ₹3,600 + DA on TA
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% government contribution
CGHS medical facilities or CSB medical scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (CEA)
